renderings.value: Express a reason or explanation; 'because', 'the reason is'.

The ～なぜなら grammar point is used to provide a reason or explanation for a preceding statement or situation. It can be translated as 'because' or 'the reason is' in English. It is often followed by から or だから to emphasize the reason or cause.
Sentence/Statement + なぜなら + Reason + から/だから
Formal written connective introducing an explanation ("the reason is..."); essays, articles, speeches.
I love this restaurant because the food is delicious.
She didn't pass the exam because she didn't study.
I won't go to see a movie because I am busy today.
He can be trusted with this project because he has a wealth of experience.
